mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (Certificate of Registration) of the foreign investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or equivalent corporate registry of the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille member state of issue): notarize the certificate, obtain a Certificate of Apostille from the competent authority designated under the Hague Apostille Convention, attach a notarized Chinese translation. Path B (non-member state of issue): notarize the certificate, authenticate it through the foreign ministry, then obtain consular legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, attach a notarized Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive, and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Corporate Status, no-dissolution and no-bankruptcy record)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies or competent corporate registry of the foreign investor's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille member state of issue): notarize the certificate, obtain an Apostille from the designated competent authority, attach a notarized Chinese translation. Path B (non-member state of issue): notarize the certificate, have it legalized by the foreign ministry, then legalized by the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, attach a notarized Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive, and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing the WFOE formation, appointment of legal representative, and bank account opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign investor (notarized execution)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille member state of issue): notarize the executed resolution or power of attorney, obtain an Apostille from the designated competent authority, attach a notarized Chinese translation. Path B (non-member state of issue): notarize the executed document, authenticate it through the foreign ministry, obtain consular legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, attach a notarized Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive, and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles of the foreign investor (certified copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign investor's registered office, corporate secretary, or issuing corporate registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille member state of issue): notarize the certified copy, obtain an Apostille from the designated competent authority, attach a notarized Chinese translation. Path B (non-member state of issue): notarize the certified copy, authenticate it through the foreign ministry, obtain consular legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, attach a notarized Chinese translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive, and must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming the foreign investor's banking relationship and credit standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing commercial bank of the foreign investor (authorized bank signatory with corporate bank seal)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille member state of issue): bank letter on bank letterhead is notarized, then an Apostille is obtained from the designated competent authority, and a notarized Chinese translation is attached. Path B (non-member state of issue): bank letter on bank letterhead is notarized, authenticated by the foreign ministry, then legalized by the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that jurisdiction, and a notarized Chinese translation is attached. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive, and must never be chained sequentially.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, every shareholder and UBO of the China WFOE must be screened against the United Nations Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and non-SDN lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list to the extent relevant, China's own sanctions and anti-money laundering watchlists, and the PBOC suspicious-transaction typology registries. Politically exposed persons are identified at direct or beneficial ownership of 25% or more or through significant control, including family members and close associates; enhanced due diligence covering source of wealth, source of funds, prior public office, adverse media, and jurisdiction risk is mandatory. The PRC AML Law, PBOC Order No. 3, and the National Anti-Money Laundering Inter-Ministerial Joint Conference requirements must be embedded in the formation documents. No nominee shareholder, bearer share, or trust concealment arrangement may be accepted for the WFOE. Screening results must be re-run within 24 hours before execution of the notarized document bundle and again before bank account opening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration and Market Entity Registration System, accessed through the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform and local market regulation bureau terminals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the SAMR Measures for the Registration and Administration of Enterprise Names, the WFOE's registered name must follow the four-tier statutory convention: administrative division, trade name, industry or business characteristics, and organization form. The name must be composed in standardized Chinese characters; Pinyin alone, Latin letters, Arabic numerals, or foreign scripts are not accepted as the registered enterprise name. The foreign investor's English name may appear as a parallel name in contracts and translations, but only the Chinese name is registered and protected. Any Pinyin or English-based phonetic transliteration used in the trade name must be distinctive, non-misleading, not identical or confusingly similar to existing nationwide enterprise names, and must comply with public order and social morality.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may submit an administrative reconsideration application to the market regulation authority at the next higher level within 60 days of the written rejection decision, or file an administrative lawsuit with the competent People's Court within 6 months. The submission must restate the proposed four-tier name, identify the statutory grounds of rejection, and attach proof of trade-name ownership or consent from prior rights holders. The applicant may also use the SAMR online name declaration portal to modify the name and request a written explanation. The reconsideration authority must issue a written decision within 60 days; if no decision is issued, the applicant may treat the inaction as a rejection and proceed to judicial review. Legal counsel may file a rebuttal memorandum arguing non-confusion, distinctiveness, and compliance with public order.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a WFOE engaged in ISIC 4100 data-center electromechanical EPC, a bare virtual office, post-office mailbox, or non-dedicated flexible desk will not satisfy the SAMR registered-address requirement, tax administration invoice and place-of-business verification requirements, or the People's Bank of China prohibition on dummy accounts. Municipal tax authorities require proof of an actual office lease, a completed housing-lease filing, and a business location matching the registered address. Banks opening the RMB basic account and foreign-exchange capital account conduct on-site inspections, verify signage, office premises, staff presence, and original lease documents; a virtual address without operational personnel is normally rejected. Some free-trade zones permit centralized registered addresses, but the WFOE must still maintain a physical project office or branch at the EPC project site, and tax authorities may require evidence of local office substance for general taxpayer and engineering-contract acceptance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) external signage matches the registered Chinese name; (2) lease agreement is in the WFOE's name and filed with the district housing authority; (3) lease term is current and rent receipts are available; (4) no mail-server-only address indication; (5) local staff are physically present with social insurance registrations; (6) original company seal, business license, labor contracts, and financial records are on site; (7) EPC contracts, subcontractor permits, and equipment invoices are accessible. Quantified risk: high. Municipal tax bureaus and SAMR randomly inspect between 10% and 20% of newly registered WFOEs; if the entity is flagged for zero tax declarations, invoice anomalies, or inconsistent premises, the probability of an unannounced physical inspection exceeds 80% within the first 12 months. Banks also perform their own on-site inspection before activating RMB basic and capital account facilities and may re-inspect every 24 months.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended on 29 December 2023), Articles 4, 23, 24, 34, 42-47, 49-55, 57-65, and 71-73; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2, 4, 29, and 31; Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746), Articles 8, 15, 17, and 24; Administration of Foreign Investment Information Reporting Provisions (Ministry of Commerce and SAMR Order), Articles 5 and 9.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Supervision Administration exercising delegated authority at the place of incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Establishment Registration of a Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company (Business Registration Dossier)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No fixed statutory minimum paid-in capital is imposed on a WFOE under current PRC Company Law; the subscribed capital, contribution form, and payment schedule are set forth in the Articles of Association and must not exceed a five-year payment period. There is no blocked escrow account requirement for ordinary paid-in capital at the company registration stage. However, for a data center mechanical and electrical EPC enterprise, the MOHURD construction qualification regime imposes minimum net asset, paid-in capital, technical personnel, and performance thresholds; therefore, the equity subscribers should preplan capital remittance and bank verification documents to support the later construction qualification application.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WE, the undersigned, being the sole director and the acting board of directors of the company provisionally designated as [Company Name] WFOE Limited (the 'Company'), duly incorporated under the laws of the People's Republic of China, and acting at the first meeting of the board of directors lawfully convened with a quorum present on [Date], do hereby resolve as follows. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: The board accepts the shareholder subscriptions and confirms that the registered capital of the Company is [Amount in CNY] divided into [Number] ordinary shares of equal par value, to be subscribed and paid in accordance with the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Contribution Schedules. The board directs the chief financial officer to open a dedicated capital contribution collection ledger, to issue capital contribution certificates only upon receipt of verified bank credit, and to ensure that all shareholder remittances comply with foreign exchange regulations and anti-money-laundering verification requirements. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: The board approves the opening of corporate RMB and foreign currency accounts with [Bank Name] and authorizes the legal representative and [Name of Authorized Officer], acting jointly, to execute account opening forms, wire transfer instructions, loan documents, and all related banking instruments. The board further delegates to the chief financial officer authority to establish daily banking exposure limits and provider signature matrices consistent with the internal control manual. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: The board adopts [Registered Address] as the Company's statutory registered office, the place where the statutory books, share register, seal register, and minutes of meetings shall be maintained, and the address for service of legal process and regulatory notices. The board instructs the company secretary to file all change-of-address notices within the legally prescribed window and to keep the address records current with banks and tax authorities. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: The board appoints [Name] as legal representative, [Name] as executive director and general manager, [Name] as supervisor, and [Name] as company secretary, each to serve until removal by shareholder resolution. The legal representative is authorized, without further board action, to execute regulatory filings, employment agreements, lease agreements, tax declarations, and construction permit applications, and to represent the Company in all proceedings before the SAMR, tax offices, the housing and urban-rural development authorities, and the fire and rescue administration. 5. GENERAL AUTHORIZATION: The board approves the common seal, contract seal, finance seal, and invoice seal designs; adopts the anti-money-laundering and internal financial control frameworks; and authorizes the company secretary to certify copies of this resolution for delivery to banks, counterparties, and government departments. This resolution is effective immediately and remains in full force and effect until repealed, varied, or replaced by a subsequent written resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Project-Specific Environmental Impact Assessment Filing and Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal or provincial Bureau of Ecology and Environment and local Fire and Rescue Administration for fire design review and site inspection
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before groundbreaking and before procurement of site utilities, undertake the statutory environmental impact classification exercise for the data center EPC project. File the Environmental Impact Registration Form online if the project does not trigger sensitive discharge thresholds, or prepare a full Environmental Impact Report Form if the project includes substantial diesel backup generation, demineralized water treatment, hazardous waste accumulation, or construction in an environmentally sensitive area. Submit the fire design documents to the local Fire and Rescue Administration for review, obtain the construction site fire safety inspection certificate, and coordinate with a licensed structural engineer to complete the structural load inspection certificate for temporary and permanent mechanical platform areas. Secure the hazardous waste disposal contract, noise mitigation plan, dust abatement plan, and waste water discharge agreement before site mobilization, and keep all clearances on-file for civil defense and labor safety audits.
required_dossiers: Environmental Impact Registration Form or full Environmental Impact Report and approval
Fire design drawings and technical specifications
Fire safety design review application and acceptance form from the Fire and Rescue Administration
Structural load inspection report for mechanical and electrical platforms
Hazardous waste transfer contract with an accredited disposal entity
Noise, dust, and water pollution prevention plans
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ecological bureau requires a higher EIA tier, immediately commission the appropriate environmental impact assessment institution, publish the required information, and resubmit with the technical review certificate; if the fire review identifies noncompliance, revise the fire protection design and resubmit the stamped drawings to the fire review panel; if the civil defense approval is withheld, procure a licensed remediation consultant and coordinate a joint reinspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) Provincial Department, together with local Construction Administration and Municipal Fire and Rescue Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Construction Enterprise Qualification Certificate, Construction Enterprise Safety Production License, and Project-Specific Construction Permit for Data Center Mechanical and Electrical EPC Works

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) provincial or municipal Bureau of Ecology and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: For a standard hyperscale data center electromechanical EPC project, the environmental rating is normally 'Environmental Impact Registration Form' subject to online filing; a full 'Environmental Impact Report Form' will be required if the project includes emergency diesel generator sets above the regulatory capacity threshold, chemical treatment and wastewater discharge, hazardous waste storage beyond one year, or any construction activity located in an ecologically sensitive zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from construction, cooling tower blowdown, and domestic site use must comply with GB 8978-1996 Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard Grade III, including pH 6-9, chemical oxygen demand not exceeding 500 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand not exceeding 300 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L, and petroleum oils not exceeding 20 mg/L. Airborne fugitive dust at the site boundary must comply with GB 16297-1996 Comprehensive Emission Standard with a boundary limit for particulates not exceeding 1.0 mg/m³, and volatile organic compounds generated by painting, sealing, and adhesive operations must meet the fugitive emission control limits of GB 37822-2019, including an allowable concentration not exceeding 40 mg/m³ and a treatment efficiency of at least 80 percent where abatement equipment applies. Hazardous waste, including waste lubricants and batteries from construction equipment, must be collected in sealed containers, stored in a licensed facility, and transferred under the electronic manifest system within the mandatory deadlines.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The project must obtain Fire Protection Design Review Acceptance and a Construction Site Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from the local Fire and Rescue Administration, including compliance with installation spacing for extinguishers, hydrant pressures, emergency egress, and temporary emergency lighting; a structural load inspection certificate issued by a licensed structural engineer confirming the adequacy of plant platforms and equipment supports; and an occupational safety approval confirming compliance with the Work Safety Law, mandatory personal protective equipment requirements, and regular worker training before issuance of the construction commencement permit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), operating through provincial and municipal Tax Service Bureaus; online tax-administration access is through the National Unified Electronic Taxation Service Platform (Electronic Tax Bureau) linked from the STA official portal at www.chinatax.gov.cn, and VAT invoice/export-rebate functions are administered on the STA VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) is first registered as a limited liability company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), which issues the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). The USCC is the PRC taxpayer identification number (TIN) and VAT taxpayer number. Within 30 days after receiving the business license, the WFOE must complete tax registration through the Electronic Tax Bureau, file its basic tax information, declare its VAT taxpayer classification, select a general tax accounting method, register its legal representative and financial officer, and activate the tax-control invoice system if applying for general VAT taxpayer status. For a non-resident enterprise that has no establishment or place of business in mainland China, the non-resident enterprise must be registered for PRC tax purposes with the competent STA office at the location where the withholding agent is located or, in the absence of a withholding agent, by direct registration in the relevant provincial Electronic Tax Bureau to obtain a Non-Resident Taxpayer Identification Number; the non-resident must also provide its certificate of tax residence for treaty relief where available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None; PRC tax law does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election for a WFOE or a hybrid mismatch election in the entity classification sense. The WFOE is taxed at entity level on its global income under corporate income tax law. The only relevant statutory election is VAT classification: a taxpayer whose annual taxable sales do not exceed RMB 5,000,000 may elect to register as a general VAT taxpayer if its accounting is sound, and that election, once made, remains in force for at least 180 days under the STA's general taxpayer administration rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the People's Republic of China VAT legislation
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: China requires all entities with taxable activities to complete tax registration after incorporation, regardless of turnover. As a separate mandatory threshold, an entity with annual taxable VAT sales exceeding RMB 5,000,000 must register as a VAT general taxpayer; an entity below that threshold may remain a small-scale taxpayer or voluntarily register as a general VAT taxpayer if eligible. For data-center EPC services, the applicable domestic VAT rates are 9% for construction/installation services and 13% for independently supplied tangible goods, if the supplies are separated; where a mixed supply is not separated, the higher rate applies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Invoices must be created using the STA-approved electronic invoice systems, including the fully digitized electronic invoice (digital invoice) platform and the tax-control UKey infrastructure. Issued invoices are transmitted in real time to the STA invoice database, and the VAT credit is recognized only after the buyer performs invoice verification and certification. Anti-fraud measures include the unified nationwide invoice code, digital tax-control signatures, automatic comparison of invoice, customs, and foreign-exchange data, and mandatory red-letter reversal procedures for cancelled or amended invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for 0% VAT when they leave PRC customs territory under a valid export customs declaration and are sold to an overseas purchaser; the exporter must be a VAT general taxpayer, must have legally acquired or produced the goods, must account for the export sale separately, and must collect the export proceeds through designated banks in the invoiced currency, with inward remittance or verified cross-border RMB settlement. Zero-rating is obtained through the export tax rebate mechanism: output VAT is charged at 0%, and the related input VAT is refunded after examination. Qualifying cross-border services, including engineering design, installation, commissioning, maintenance and electronic-data-related services performed for recipients outside mainland China and consumed wholly outside China, may be zero-rated or VAT-exempt if they appear in the STA's cross-border taxable services catalogue, are performed offshore, are settled in the agreed currency, and are evidenced by a cross-border service contract and the overseas recipient's non-resident status.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Goods Customs Declaration (Customs Export Declaration)
clean on-board Bill of Lading or equivalent international transport waybill
commercial invoice and export sales contract
packing list and export goods inspection or quarantine certificate where statutory inspection applies
VAT invoice issued under the STA invoice system and input VAT certification documents
bank foreign-exchange settlement or collection receipt, or SAFE export-proceeds verification/collection record evidencing inward remittance of export payment
certificate of origin or other jurisdictional trade documents where the importer requires them
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA may launch an export tax rebate audit by cross-matching the export declaration, logistics, customs clearance, bank foreign-exchange receipt, and VAT invoice data. If the zero-rating application cannot be substantiated, the 0% rate is revoked, the transaction is re-characterized as domestic taxable supply, output VAT is reimposed at 13% or the applicable rate, input VAT credits are denied, late-payment interest runs from the original filing date, and a tax penalty of 50% to five times the underpaid or rebate amount may be imposed under the Law on Tax Administration and Tax Collection. Fraudulent export-tax-rebate claims carry mandatory clawback, a penalty of one to five times the fraudulently obtained rebate, and criminal liability for export tax rebate fraud under PRC criminal law and the relevant judicial interpretation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), with enforcement delegated to SAFE branch offices and the ASOne national trade-monitoring system
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with strict current-account convertibility and tightly controlled capital-account convertibility. Current-account receipts and payments for trade in goods and services are generally convertible through licensed designated foreign-exchange banks, but every transaction must pass authenticity verification and be backed by commercial documents such as contracts, invoices, customs declarations, and tax vouchers. Capital-account transactions remain heavily regulated: foreign direct investment into a WFOE requires SAFE registration, a dedicated FDI capital account, and post-registration reporting. Profit repatriation is treated as a current-account outflow once distributable profits are verified, so it requires audited financial statements, tax payment certificates, and a completed annual SAFE foreign-investment reporting cycle. The central hurdles for a data-center EPC treasury are (i) demonstrating that each foreign-currency inflow matches the approved business scope, (ii) proving that any payments to overseas equipment suppliers are commercially genuine under the master EPC contract, and (iii) complying with the prohibition on using capital-account settlement proceeds for purposes beyond normal operational scope such as securities investment, real-estate speculation, or unrelated shareholder debt repayment. In practice the RMB is convertible for operating liquidity, but conversion agility is limited by real-demand underwriting and post-transaction verification, so treasury operations must be planned with documentary lead times and conservative liquidity buffers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For goods-export proceeds, SAFE requires repatriation to a licensed bank's foreign-exchange settlement account within 90 days of the export customs clearance date unless an extended deferred-payment timetable is approved prior to shipment. Once received onshore, the proceeds must be either settled into CNY or retained in a permitted foreign-exchange settling account within 5 working days. The mandatory conversion ratio is currently zero, meaning the WFOE may lawfully retain 100% of its export proceeds in foreign currency, although every inflow and outflow must be reported through the ASOne trade-monitoring system and matched to the underlying customs declaration.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMI platforms are effectively barred from providing primary corporate banking services to a Mainland-China incorporated WFOE. The PBOC and SAFE recognize only locally licensed commercial banks as providers of foreign-exchange settlement, CNY clearing, and capital-account custody. A foreign EMI cannot hold an SAFE foreign-exchange desigination, cannot open a Capital Escrow Account on behalf of the WFOE, and cannot participate in CIPS or CNAPS as a clearing member. The viability of an offshore digital EMI for this entity is therefore low; it may be used only as a non-executing treasury dashboard or a front-end API that relies on a regulated local bank as the true execution layer. Any independent EMI solution that advertises CNY conversion or onshore settlement for a Chinese legal entity is legally non-viable and would create AML and licensing exposure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under PBOC rules for RMB bank settlement accounts, the WFOE's legal representative must appear physically at the branch when opening the Basic Operational Currency Account; remote consular proxy opening is not permitted for that account class. For the FDI Capital Escrow Account, the legal representative may be represented by a person holding a notarized and legalized power of attorney, but the bank will typically require the foreign legal representative to be present for a live video interview and may additionally require a bank officer to perform a site visit to the WFOE's registered office or project site. At least one statutory director with actual attestation power must personally attend the KYC interview, present the original business license and company chop, and confirm the UBO structure under the bank's customer due diligence policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain terminates in an offshore holding company and the beneficial-owner evidence is stale or inconsistent across multiple intermediary entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extracts from each offshore corporate register, a group ownership chart signed and sealed by every level of the holding structure, current register of directors and shareholders, UBO declarations dated within the last six months, passport or national-ID copies of each UBO, and a legal opinion from licensed counsel confirming that no nominee or undisclosed family-controlled ownership arrangement exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large advance payments are scheduled to subcontractors or equipment vendors before the EPC contract has been notarized and before bank documentation is complete, creating a high risk of misappropriated trade proceeds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized bilingual EPC master contract, itemized budget schedule, invoice breakdowns, supplier due-diligence packs including business licenses and tax registration certificates, customs tariff classifications for electromechanical and cooling equipment within ISIC 4100 scope, a monthly cash-flow drawdown schedule linked to progress certificates, and third-party inspection reports confirming the underlying physical project.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The initial capital injection amount materially exceeds the minimum capital required by the WFOE's business scope and is not supported by an economic forecast, raising possible round-tripping or speculative capital inflows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed feasibility study and 5-year cash-flow model for the hyperscale data-center facility, audited financial statements of the ultimate shareholder, board resolution approving the equity injection, a certified capital-adequacy statement signed by the WFOE's statutory representative, and a post-injection statutory capital verification report (issued by a licensed accounting firm) filed with SAFE within 30 days of receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment routing uses a third-country clearing agent or transit bank that is not named in the EPC contract and appears on international sanctions or high-risk jurisdiction watchlists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening results for all counterparties, a global bank watchlist clearance letter, end-beneficiary undertaking signed by the ultimate supplier, original purchase order and invoice identifying the legal entity, draft bill of lading or airway bill, a tax-residence certificate of the third-country agent, and a written explanation of why direct SWIFT payment to the final beneficiary is commercially necessary.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing for shareholder equity injection is: (1) open an SAFE-registered FDI capital account at a tier-1 domestic commercial bank; (2) submit the foreign-investment registration confirmation obtained from SAFE; (3) instruct the overseas shareholder to remit via SWIFT MT103 using the standard SAFE international balance-of-payments purpose code for FDI equity contribution (typically 6221 in bank systems); (4) the receiving bank checks the remitter identity, UBO, and purpose code against the SAFE backup file before crediting the capital account; (5) after crediting, the WFOE may settle the foreign currency into CNY through the capital settlement mechanism, but the CNY proceeds may be used only for business purposes approved by SAFE, including project expenses, equipment purchases, wages, or subcontractor payments. A statutory capital verification report from a licensed accounting firm must be produced after the injection is completed to perfect the WFOE formation record.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For disbursements to overseas equipment suppliers and engineering subcontractors, the clearing rails are: (a) SWIFT MT103 direct corporate wire after presentation of the EPC contract, invoice, customs declaration, and tax-payment slips; (b) commercial letter of credit issued by the local bank on a cash-collateralized or corporate-guarantee basis, settled through SWIFT MT700/MT799 messages for electromechanical and cooling-system imports; (c) documentary collections (D/P or D/A) for lower-value and burst-supply consignments; and (d) domestic subcontractor settlements in CNY through CNAPS RTGS using the WFOE's Basic Operational Currency Account. Where the receiving domestic party is a Chinese resident, the bank can also use CIPS for the CNY leg, reducing reliance on the USD-correspondent chain. All outbound FX payments must be matched to the correct SAFE BOP purpose code, typically under the goods-trade or project-engineering-service category, and the documentary audit trail must be retained for at least five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY forward contracts (yuan-settlement forward agreements) executed with a licensed tier-1 domestic commercial bank and supported by real underlying EPC project cash-flow documents
Onshore CNY foreign-currency swaps matching known receivable and payable maturity dates, subject to SAFE real-demand verification and bank internal limit approval
Plain-vanilla CNY call and put options with the tier-1 bank for hedging invoice-level foreign-exchange exposure as long as the options are terminal-delivery only and not speculative
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CCIRS) used to hedge long-term foreign-currency project obligations where the underlying loan or financing structure has obtained prior SAFE registration

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for mainland-incorporated WFOEs due to the SAFE real-demand principle; any offshore NDF overlay arranged by the parent must be wound down and replaced by an onshore deliverable hedge

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Report and Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Information Report (jointly submitted under the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) joint annual reporting platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 of each calendar year for the immediately preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit by June 30 triggers listing on the abnormal operations directory within 10 working days; failure to remedy for three consecutive years leads to inclusion in the serious illegal/illegal list and administrative strike-off or revocation of the business license by SAMR. False reporting may incur fines up to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 1,400) and credit disciplinary sanctions on the foreign investor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Filing (Final Settlement of Income Tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) – local tax bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 31 of the year following each tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unpaid tax accrues overdue interest at 0.05% per day (equivalent to 18.25% per annum); late filing penalties of RMB 2,000 to RMB 20,000 apply; underpayment penalties range from 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax amount. Persistent default can lead to enforced seizure of bank deposits and assets, suspension of tax refunds, and administrative deregistration proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Annual Foreign Exchange Registration Reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via the Direct Investment Foreign Exchange Management System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of each year, aligned with the SAMR annual report period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or inaccurate filing results in temporary suspension of foreign exchange capital account procedures, inability to repatriate profits or convert dividends, and adverse credit records at SAFE. Administrative fines of RMB 30,000 to RMB 500,000 may be imposed for serious violations under the Provisional Regulations on Foreign Exchange Control.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Statutory Audit Report (Independent Chinese CPA Audit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders/Board of Directors; the audited report must be made available to SAMR, STA, customs, banks and other regulatory users upon statutory request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end (by April 30) so that the audited statements can support the June 30 annual information report and May 31 CIT final settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to undertake the audit violates Article 164 of the PRC Company Law. The finance regulatory authority may order correction, impose fines on the company and on responsible executives, and the enterprise may lose audit-dependent eligibility for bank credit, government tenders, tax preferential treatment and administrative licenses. The company may also be moved to the abnormal operation directory.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Construction Enterprise Annual Statistical Declaration for Engineering and EPC Activities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) and Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (MOHURD) through local municipal and provincial bureaus
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual statistics period generally due before March 10 of the succeeding year; monthly data submissions are separately required for active construction EPC enterprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted declarations can trigger down-rating of the construction enterprise qualification, express inclusion in the credit violation list, suspension from bidding on public construction projects, and administrative revocation of the EPC business license in serious recurring cases.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No quantitative balance-sheet, turnover or headcount threshold provides an audit exemption for a Chinese wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the PRC Company Law. Article 164 mandates an independent CPA audit for every company at the end of each fiscal year, and foreign-invested enterprises remain subject to that universal obligation regardless of size, revenue or number of employees. For classification purposes only, PRC SME threshold criteria (e.g., industrial enterprises with annual sales below RMB 20 million and total assets below RMB 30 million) may qualify the entity to prepare simplified accounts under the Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises, but this does not waive the statutory audit duty; the WFOE must still engage an independent Chinese CPA firm to audit its annual financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (ASBE), which are substantively converged with IFRS; where eligible, the Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises (ASSE) may be used for reporting simplification, but if the entity conducts meaningful construction EPC operations, engages in cross-border transactions, or uses foreign investment, ASBE is the expected governing framework, supplemented by the full text of the PRC Company Law and the PRC Accounting Law.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not maintain a stand-alone annual UBO register for all companies, but the WFOE must disclose beneficial ownership information within the annual Foreign-Invested Enterprise Information Report submitted to SAMR/MOFCOM between January 1 and June 30. Any equity transfer, change in registered capital or change of final shareholder/beneficial owner must be filed with SAMR within 30 days after the legal effective date of the change. In parallel, changes affecting tax registration or cross-border tax identity must be reported to the STA within 30 days. Non-compliance exposes the entity to abnormal-operation listing, fines, suspension of foreign exchange proceedings and adverse credit sanctions.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,000 – USD 3,000 (annual registered address service inclusive of local administrative correspondence handling in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 city)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 8,000 (typical qualified Chinese CPA firm charge for a mid-market Hyperscale Datacenter EPC WFOE with construction revenue, depending on scale and consolidation complexity)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: For a datacenter electromechanical EPC WFOE in mainland China, the headline corporate income tax rate is 25%. No general statutory tax holiday is available to an EPC contractor, but qualifying income from new public infrastructure project operation may enjoy a three-year full exemption followed by a three-year 50% reduction under EIT Law Article 27 and the Public Infrastructure Catalogue. Preferential effective rates include: 15% for High and New Technology Enterprise status, 15% for encouraged industries in western regions or Hainan Free Trade Zone, and 15% for qualified advanced technology services enterprises. Qualifying R&D expenditure may be deducted at 200% of the incurred amount, and qualified technology transfer income is exempt up to CNY 5 million with 50% exemption on the excess. Small and low-profit enterprises may benefit from reduced rates, but a hyperscale EPC WFOE will typically exceed those thresholds.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 - Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Category A), supplemented by schedules A101010, A102010, A103000, A104000, A105000 and the annual related-party transaction report; filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau portal (e-Tax) or by paper at the competent tax authority of the WFOE registered address. Quarterly provisional filings use Form A200000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual reconciliation with quarterly prepayments; the annual return is filed once per tax year and the quarterly prepayments are filed for each calendar quarter.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly EIT prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter; the annual EIT return and full balance payment for the preceding tax year must be submitted no later than 31 May of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue from the sale of construction services, engineering procurement and construction project income, datacenter mechanical and cooling equipment integration, commissioning services, and after-sales operation and maintenance income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must recognize revenue under PRC GAAP using the percentage-of-completion or completed-contract method as contract terms dictate. Because the EPC project is performed in China, 100% of the contract price is PRC-source revenue; if the contract is structured with foreign subcontractors, the WFOE must maintain evidence that any allocation of revenue to a foreign head office is supported by a permanent establishment analysis and transfer pricing documentation. All progress certificates, equipment delivery records and subcontract invoices must reconcile with the VAT invoice system.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs including labor, datacenter electromechanical equipment, raw materials, construction subcontracts, cooling and mechanical systems installation, project supervision, and overhead attributable to completed projects.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany equipment purchases and technical services from offshore affiliates must be arm's length. Imported datacenter equipment should be excluded from PRC-source service revenue only if title passes abroad and no PRC permanent establishment risk is created. Cost allocations from overseas headquarters require contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation, and related-party service charges must satisfy the benefit test and deductibility rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT surcharges, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge, stamp duty, property tax, land use tax, and other deductible business taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: VAT is excluded from the EIT revenue base. The surcharges are deductible for EIT purposes. The WFOE must reconcile VAT general taxpayer output tax, input tax credits, and project-site surcharge allocations. Any fraudulent input VAT credit will result in a full add-back, penalty and criminal exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing expenses, bid and tender fees, business entertainment, project development expenses, overseas business development, branding, and commission expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Business entertainment is deductible only up to 60% of the eligible amount and cannot exceed 5 per thousand of qualified revenue. Overseas commission payments must be supported by actual service evidence and beneficial ownership analysis. Payments to offshore marketing agents may be treated as China-source service fees subject to withholding tax if the services are performed in or exploited in China, and a service transfer pricing analysis must be maintained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Head-office management expenses, office rent, administrative salaries, professional fees, R&D expenditure, patent licensing, and general overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees allocated from the foreign parent are deductible only if the WFOE obtains compliant invoices, the expenses relate to actual operations, and the allocation method is arm's length. Management fees paid without specific services are non-deductible. R&D super-deduction must be documented in the project-level schedule with contemporaneous project files.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest expense, bank facility fees, foreign exchange gains or losses, guarantee fees, and other financing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest on related-party cross-border loans is non-deductible to the extent that related-party debt exceeds a 2:1 debt-equity ratio, with a 1:1 ratio for financial institutions. The interest must be at arm's length and must not exceed the general market rate. The WFOE must withhold 10% WHT on interest paid to an offshore lender unless treaty relief is approved. Failure to withhold creates a collection obligation, interest, and penalties against the WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Gains or Losses on Disposal of Assets
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable gains or losses from disposal of fixed assets, intangible assets, long-term equity interests, and EPC project equipment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE disposes of a hyperscale datacenter facility or mechanical and cooling equipment before full depreciation, the gain is subject to EIT. A cross-border sale of shares in the WFOE by the offshore parent may expose the seller to PRC tax under Circular 7 anti-avoidance rules where the shares derive more than 50% of their value from PRC real property.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Grants, subsidies, penalties received, asset donations, debt restructuring gains, and unrelated non-operating losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Government subsidies that meet the fiscal appropriation conditions under SAT Inspection Announcement 70 are exempt income. Subsidies for datacenter energy efficiency or cooling technology promotion may be taxable if not in the exempt catalogue. Donations to qualifying PRC charitable institutions are deductible up to 12% of accounting total profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 9 - Accounting Total Profit and Tax Adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net profit before tax, reconciled to taxable income through Schedule A105000 adjustments, tax-exempt income offsets, loss carryforwards, and non-deductible items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must trace every intercompany invoice, contract, management charge and interest payment to the adjustment schedule. Transfer pricing adjustments, foreign tax credits, related-party interest above thin capitalization limits, and non-deductible management fees are added back. Tax losses may be carried forward five years only, except where HNTE or advanced technology service status permits a ten-year carryforward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 - Tax Credits, Withholding and Related-Party Disclosure
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, tax treaty credits, dividend withholding tax credits, controlled foreign enterprise disclosures, and the annual related-party transaction declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE receives dividends from an overseas affiliate, the foreign tax credit is limited to the PRC tax attributable to the same income. A non-resident parent cannot offset PRC tax on the WFOE profits through the WFOE return. Dividends distributed by the WFOE to the parent are subject to WHT at the time of distribution; the parent must provide a current Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership file to invoke treaty relief.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual filing may result in an administrative fine up to CNY 2,000, increased to CNY 2,000-10,000 for serious cases. Late tax payment accrues a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. Underpayment from false declaration exposes the WFOE to a penalty of 50%-500% of the underpaid tax. Criminal tax evasion occurs when the company conceals taxable income and the underpaid tax is significant and more than 10% of the tax due, with imprisonment up to three years, or three to seven years for especially large amounts. Fraudulent issuance of special VAT invoices can result in imprisonment up to life. The tax authority may blacklist the WFOE and impose travel bans on responsible persons until all tax, interest, penalties and security are settled.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 3 and Article 37 plus Detailed Implementation Rules Article 91. A resident WFOE declaring dividends to a non-PRC corporate parent must withhold 10%; no EIT withholding is imposed on a dividend distribution from a PRC resident enterprise to another qualifying PRC resident enterprise in a direct investment relationship.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA rate on dividends, the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate from its jurisdiction of residence; (2) file the Non-resident Taxpayer Treaty Benefit application through the withholding agent on the PRC electronic tax platform; (3) demonstrate beneficial ownership under SAT Announcements 60/2015 and 9/2018, including substantive business activities, employees, bank accounts, board discretion, economic risk, and absence of a conduit arrangement; (4) satisfy the treaty holding condition, commonly at least 10% direct ownership and in some treaties a 365-day holding period; and (5) provide the TRC, audited financial statements, ownership chart, and a statement confirming the recipient is not legally or economically obliged to pass the dividend to a third jurisdiction. Overwithheld tax may be refunded by application to the competent tax authority within three years of the statutory payment date.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest paid by a PRC WFOE to a non-resident enterprise are subject to statutory 10% WHT on the gross amount as China-source income. Most PRC DTA treaties reduce interest and royalty withholding to 10%; certain treaties provide 5% or 7% depending on the nature of the interest, the substantial-ownership condition, or the character of the royalty. Treaty relief requires a current TRC, beneficial ownership proof, limitation-on-benefits compliance, and China-source substantiation. Payments for the use of industrial, commercial, or scientific equipment may be characterized as rental income rather than royalties in certain treaties. Intercompany service fees are subject to 10% withholding when the services are rendered in China, and are not treated as royalties unless the essential right to exploit an intellectual property asset is conferred.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: RMB: a Chinese WFOE must contemporaneously prepare a Local File and submit the annual related-party transaction declaration when total related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million, with per-category thresholds of RMB 100 million for tangible asset and financial asset transfers and RMB 40 million for intangible property transfers and related-party services. A Master File is mandatory when the multinational group has consolidated annual revenue above RMB 1 billion and has controlled non-resident entities or related-party transactions meeting specific criteria, and all documentation must be produced in Chinese within 15 days of a request by the State Taxation Administration.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China applies EIT Law Article 47 and the substance-over-form doctrine, requiring a WFOE to have genuine business purpose, actual employees, premises, decision-making authority, assets, and risk-bearing capacity in China. The State Taxation Administration uses the Beneficial Ownership standard of Announcement 9/2018 to deny treaty benefits to letterbox companies that lack discretionary control, employees, bank accounts and substantive operations. Although China Mainland does not administer offshore ESR/CIGA return filings, OECD BEPS Action 5 transparency, country-by-country reporting, and the authorized OECD approach to permanent establishment apply. A datacenter EPC WFOE must align its functional and risk profile with the intercompany contractual allocation; otherwise the tax authority may recharacterize income, attribute profit to a PRC permanent establishment, deny treaty relief, and impose transfer pricing adjustments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Invoicing and Fraudulent VAT Credit in EPC Subcontracting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE issues or accepts false special VAT invoices from shell subcontractors to inflate datacenter project costs, fabricate construction progress, or create artificial losses on cooling and electromechanical works, thereby understating corporate taxable income and claiming fraudulent input VAT credits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Criminal Law Articles 205 and 210, issuing or obtaining false special VAT invoices triggers confiscation, fines up to RMB 500,000 and imprisonment up to life. The tax authority recovers underpaid EIT, VAT, surcharges, a daily 0.05% late payment surcharge, and imposes a 50%-500% penalty under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63. The entity is placed on the serious tax violation blacklist and loses access to customs facilitation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, CFO, finance officer, or any person directly responsible who signs or directs the false invoicing can be prosecuted personally. Criminal fines and restitution of unpaid tax may be enforced from personal assets. The responsible person is subject to a travel ban and exit restriction under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 44 until all tax, interest, penalties and a guarantee are settled. The court may pierce the corporate veil if company and personal assets are commingled or the WFOE is used solely as a criminal instrument, leading to personal civil liability for the entire tax loss and imprisonment up to life for serious VAT invoice fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation Through Offshore Management, Royalty, and Financing Charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE pays excessive management fees, royalties for non-existent or obsolete datacenter cooling technology, or inflated intercompany interest on loans from an offshore conduit, stripping profits out of China while the WFOE is reduced to a risk-limited subcontractor. No Local File or Master File is maintained, and the arm's length net margin is engineered to zero or a loss.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under EIT Law Articles 41, 46, 48 and 114 of the Detailed Implementation Rules, the tax authority may adjust the taxable income to an arm's length level, disallow interest beyond the thin capitalization ratio, recharacterize disguised interest or royalty distributions as dividends, impose the 10% WHT on deemed dividend distributions, and assess the 0.05% per-day surcharge. Failure to provide contemporaneous documentation may increase the interest rate applied to the adjustment and separately incur penalties for non-filing of the related-party transaction declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the legal representative may be civilly liable to compensate the WFOE for the adjusted tax, interest, and penalties if their negligence breached fiduciary duties under the PRC Company Law. A travel ban may be issued against the legal representative for the full amount of the adjusted tax, interest and fines. If the structure concealed substantial taxable income and the underpaid tax exceeds the criminal evasion threshold with over 10% of the tax due, the directly responsible officers face criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201, with imprisonment up to seven years for the most serious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Entity Abuse, Treaty Shopping, and Unpaid Dividend or Interest Withholding Tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE operates as a letterbox entity with no employees, no physical office, no active board or management in mainland China. It books the full EPC contract revenue in China while receiving all execution services from an offshore parent, pays dividends and interest to an offshore holding company structured solely to invoke a reduced DTA rate, and fails to report or withhold the statutory 10% WHT on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The competent tax authority may disregard the corporate personality under the general anti-avoidance rule in EIT Law Article 47 and SAT Announcement 9/2018, deny DTA benefits, and recharacterize the offshore conduit as a tax resident of China or a permanent establishment. The full 10% withholding tax is assessed on the gross remittance, with a 0.05% per-day late surcharge and a withholding penalty of up to 100% of the unpaid WHT under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69. The WFOE is added to the serious dishonesty tax blacklist, subject to public notice, tightened tax administration, and cross-border compliance restrictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally ordered to make restitution of the unpaid withholding tax, interest and penalties if the WFOE lacks assets and the directors caused the distribution without withholding. Under PRC Company Law, the limited liability veil is pierced when the shareholder or director abuses the corporate form to the detriment of state revenue or creditors. The legal representative, tax officer and controlling directors are jointly and severally liable where collusion is proven. The responsible person is blacklisted and prevented from leaving China until all tax, interest, fines and security are paid. In severe cases involving intentional concealment through a cross-border conduit structure, criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 201 may result in imprisonment of three to seven years.
